name: Caffe Main Screen
description: Design Graph of the Caffe espresso-brewing main screen (MainPage), an Uno Platform app composed of custom UserControls with a CommunityToolkit.Mvvm MainViewModel.

evidence.rationale: Grid x:Name=MainContent wrapping a ScrollViewer + vertical AutoLayout; hidden while brewing.
2x2 Grid of the four EspressoCard instances with responsive 8/12 gutters.
Vertical AutoLayout holding the three parameter controls, the selection overview, and the brew button; moves beside the card grid at Wide breakpoint.

properties.accentBar: two-tone 56x4 bar, primary left half / accent-red right half
two-tone 36x3 bar, colors reversed from header (accent-red left / primary right)

properties.checkmark: 24x24 primary circle with FontIcon glyph E73E, visible only when selected

properties.thermometer: track + gradient fill (temperature-low to temperature-high) + accent-red bulb; fill height driven from value in code-behind

properties.arc: 240-degree gauge: border-colored background arc, accent-green sweet-spot segment (25-30s, opacity 0.3), primary value arc updated in code-behind; center shows seconds + SECONDS caption

properties.sizeButtons: three circular buttons of increasing diameter (S/M/L); selected one filled with primary, others with border color (code-behind)
properties.particleDisplay: grid of particle-colored dots regenerated per grind level in code-behind (finer = more, smaller dots)

properties.textBinding: ViewModel.BrewButtonText ('Select your espresso' when nothing selected, 'Brew {Name}' otherwise)

properties.progressBinding: ViewModel.BrewProgress (OneWay, 0-1 over ~2.5s); drives coffee-fill height (0-45px) and parameters-text opacity pulse in code-behind
properties.cup: outlined cup + handle + saucer drawn with text-primary borders; fill uses coffee-dark to coffee-light gradient

evidence.rationale: ViewModel.IsBrewing set true for ~2.5s by BrewCommand; MainContent hidden via ReverseBoolToVisibilityConverter and BrewingScreen loaded via x:Load.

properties.effect: MainContent collapsed; BrewingScreen overlay shown with animated progress

evidence.rationale: IsSelected dependency property (set from MainPage.UpdateCardSelections) swaps border brush to primary and shows the checkmark badge.

properties.exclusive: at most one of the four cards at a time

evidence.rationale: IsBrewEnabled=false (no espresso selected) sets background to CaffePrimaryDisabledBrush, disables the button, and label reads 'Select your espresso'. This is the initial state.

properties.effect: Background CaffePrimaryBrush -> CaffePrimaryDisabledBrush; IsEnabled=false; text 'Select your espresso'

evidence.rationale: Visibility is bound to ViewModel.HasSelection; the overview is collapsed until an espresso is selected. This is the initial state.
Base value only; CaffePrimaryHoverBrush (#14352A) is an interaction variant folded per token rules.
Not an interaction-only variant: the brew button's modeled (and initial) disabled state rests on this value.
Same value as text-primary but a distinct declared resource; kept separate per token rules.
Same value as accent-red but a distinct declared resource; kept separate per token rules.
CornerRadius=14 recurs on EspressoCard, SelectionOverview, and BrewButton; no declared resource key exists.
Bottom margin of 16 recurs between the page's stacked sections (espresso grid, parameters panel, brew button); no declared resource key exists.
BrewingScreen overlay sits in the page root Grid above MainContent, x:Load-gated on IsBrewing.
Whole-screen condition: main content swaps for the brewing overlay.
Tapped handlers (OnEspressoCardTapped etc.) set ViewModel.SelectedEspresso; UpdateCardSelections then marks the tapped card selected.

properties.appliesTo: label and range labels via ParameterLabelTextStyle
labels and values via Overview styles
cup, handle and saucer outlines; title via BrewingTitleTextStyle

unresolved.question: Should TemperatureGauge, ExtractionArc, and GrindSelector be modeled as instances/variants of one canonical 'parameter card' component?
unresolved.reason: They share identical outer treatment (surface card, responsive 12/16 radius, ThemeShadow, label/visual/value/control/range-label row structure) but are three distinct UserControl classes with different interaction models; the source declares no shared base or style.

unresolved.question: Do the Material palette overrides in Styles/ColorPaletteOverride.xaml (PrimaryColor, OutlineColor, etc.) belong in this screen's token set via the default Slider/Button theme styles?
possibleValues: include the subset consumed by default control templates on this screen
unresolved.reason: The sliders and buttons use default control templates whose theme resources resolve through the palette override; per token-scope rules the full palette was not enumerated in this screen graph.

unresolved.question: Where is CaffePrimaryHoverBrush (#14352A) consumed?
unresolved.reason: The brush is declared in AppResources.xaml but no XAML or code-behind in the modeled surface references it; treated as an interaction-only variant of primary and folded per token rules.

metadata.notes: Page composes custom UserControls; each is modeled at canonical-component altitude with internals as properties. Brew progress (0-1) is modeled as a property of component.brewing-screen, not a discrete state.
